summary_zh: 本页展示了成语“假痴不癫”的标题，配图是一位穿着古装、手持瓦罐、看似疯癫的老者，暗示该成语的含义。

page_text_ocr_zh: 三国时期，魏国的皇帝去世了，新继位的小皇帝才八岁，治国大权就落在了太尉司马懿和大将军曹爽的手中。司马懿是魏国的三朝元老，掌着兵权，有勇有谋；曹爽是皇室宗亲，跟皇帝是一家人，皇帝非常信任他。
page_text_en: During the Three Kingdoms period, the emperor of Wei died. The new emperor was only eight years old, so the power of governing the country fell into the hands of Taiwei Sima Yi and General Cao Shuang. Sima Yi was a veteran minister of three dynasties in Wei, holding military power and being brave and wise; Cao Shuang was a member of the imperial family, related to the emperor, and the emperor trusted him very much.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了三国时期魏国皇帝去世后，年仅八岁的小皇帝继位，国家大权由太尉司马懿和大将军曹爽共同掌握的背景，为后续故事发展做铺垫。

page_text_ocr_zh: 可是，一山不容二虎，司马懿和曹爽为了争夺权力，斗得难分难解。几年后，曹爽夺走了司马懿的兵权。司马懿斗输了，只好唉声叹气地向皇帝请求：‘臣快七十岁了，年纪大了，眼花背驼，路也走不动了，没有力气上朝，请求陛下让我回家养病吧！’
page_text_en: However, two tigers cannot share one mountain. Sima Yi and Cao Shuang fought fiercely for power, unable to resolve their conflict. A few years later, Cao Shuang seized Sima Yi's military authority. Having lost the struggle, Sima Yi sighed and petitioned the emperor: 'I am nearly seventy years old. I am old, my eyesight is failing, my back is hunched, I can't even walk, and I lack the strength to attend court. I beg Your Majesty to allow me to return home to recuperate from illness!'
summary_zh: 本页讲述了司马懿与曹爽争权失败后，假装年老体衰，向皇帝请求辞官归隐的情节，为后续‘假痴不癫’的策略做铺垫。

page_text_ocr_zh: 皇帝看司马懿头发和胡子花白，说一句话要喘三喘，走起路来颤颤巍巍，便赏赐他许多金银财宝，让他回家去了。这样一来，朝中大事，都是大将军曹爽一个人说了算。曹爽一下子骄傲自大起来，吃穿都要和皇帝一模一样。
page_text_en: The emperor saw that Sima Yi's hair and beard were white, that he had to catch his breath three times after speaking a single sentence, and that he walked unsteadily. So he rewarded him with much gold and silver, and sent him home. From then on, all major affairs in the court were decided by General Cao Shuang alone. Cao Shuang became arrogant and proud, wanting to dress and eat just like the emperor.
summary_zh: 皇帝因司马懿年老体衰而准其辞官归隐，导致大将军曹爽独揽大权，变得骄傲自大，生活奢靡，与皇帝无异。

page_text_ocr_zh: 皇帝吃了一种新点心，第二天早上，曹爽的餐桌上也摆上了同款点心。皇帝穿了一件新衣裳，曹爽就要让人连夜给他也赶制一件。就连官员们敬献给皇帝的珍宝，曹爽也要事先挑出自己喜欢的，再把剩下的送进皇宫。
page_text_en: The emperor ate a new kind of snack. The next morning, the same snack appeared on Cao Shuang's dining table. When the emperor wore a new garment, Cao Shuang immediately ordered someone to make an identical one for himself overnight. Even when officials presented treasures to the emperor, Cao Shuang would first pick out the ones he liked, then send the rest to the palace.
summary_zh: 本页描述了曹爽独揽大权后，处处模仿皇帝、生活奢靡的行为，包括享用与皇帝相同的点心、衣物，以及优先挑选进贡珍宝，表现出其骄横跋扈的作风。

page_text_ocr_zh: 曹爽有两个兄弟，掌管着都城内的禁军。他们三个人经常一起出城去打猎，有一位官员提醒曹爽："大将军，你们兄弟三人一起出城，如果有人在里面关上城门，城内禁军无人指挥，你们在城外也没有人保护，那多危险呀！"曹爽大眼一瞪，说："谁胆大包天，敢把我们关在城外！"
page_text_en: Cao Shuang had two brothers who commanded the imperial guards within the capital city. The three of them often went hunting outside the city together. One official warned Cao Shuang: "General, if the three of you go out together, and someone inside closes the city gates, the guards within the city will have no commander, and you outside will have no protection. How dangerous that would be!" Cao Shuang glared and said: "Who dares to be so bold as to leave us trapped outside the city!"
summary_zh: 本页描述了曹爽与其兄弟掌管禁军，常一起出城打猎，一位官员提醒其危险，曹爽却傲慢回应，表现出其骄横无忌的性格。

page_text_ocr_zh: 不过，曹爽眼珠子一转，又说道："在魏国，只有司马懿敢跟我作对。这只老狐狸，现在天天躲在家里，也不知道是真病还是装病，我得派人去瞧瞧。"刚巧，他的亲信李胜要去荆州做官。于是，曹爽便让李胜去向司马懿辞行，探探他的病情。
page_text_en: However, Cao Shuang's eyes darted around, and he said, "In the Wei Kingdom, only Sima Yi dares to oppose me. This old fox is hiding at home every day. I don't know if he's truly ill or pretending. I must send someone to check on him." Coincidentally, his trusted aide Li Sheng was about to take up a post in Jingzhou. So, Cao Shuang sent Li Sheng to bid farewell to Sima Yi, to secretly investigate his condition.
summary_zh: 曹爽怀疑司马懿装病，决定派亲信李胜前去探病，借辞行之名暗中查探司马懿的真实状况。

page_text_ocr_zh: 司马懿正坐在家里，一边喝茶看书，一边晒太阳。忽然，他听到禀报："李刺史上门拜访。"司马懿大笑："哈哈哈，终于来了！"他放下书，脱了外衣，抓乱头发，又在脸上涂了面粉，躺到了床上。
page_text_en: Simayi was sitting at home, drinking tea and reading a book while basking in the sun. Suddenly, he heard the report: "Governor Li has come to visit." Simayi laughed loudly: "Hahaha, he's finally here!" He put down his book, took off his outer robe, ruffled his hair, smeared flour on his face, and lay down on the bed.
summary_zh: 司马懿得知李胜前来探病，故意装病，脱衣、乱发、涂面粉，躺在床上，以示病重。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“快，快扶我起来！”司马懿想从床上坐起来，可胳膊刚撑住就没了力气，又“砰”地倒回了床上。他又想拿外衣披上，可是手抖个不停，衣服一下子滑到了地上。

婢女领着李胜来到司马懿的卧房。李胜见司马懿脸色苍白，头发像一蓬乱草似的，房间里还飘着浓浓的中药味。
page_text_en:
"Hurry, hurry, help me up!" Sima Yi tried to sit up from bed, but as soon as his arms braced, he lost strength and fell back onto the bed with a "thud." He then tried to put on his outer robe, but his hands trembled uncontrollably, and the garment slipped to the floor.

The maid led Li Sheng to Sima Yi's bedroom. Li Sheng saw that Sima Yi's face was pale, his hair was like a tangled mess of grass, and the room was filled with the strong smell of herbal medicine.
summary_zh: 司马懿假装病重，李胜前来探病时，他故意表现得虚弱不堪，脸色苍白、手抖、头发凌乱，房间弥漫中药味，以迷惑对方。

page_text_ocr_zh:
婢女赶紧过去，扶着司马懿靠坐在床上。
司马懿指了指自己的嘴，婢女立刻端来一碗粥。司马懿接过粥碗，想自己喝，可他的手哆哆嗦嗦，碗怎么也送不到嘴边去。婢女接回了碗，用勺子一勺一勺地喂给他。粥顺着司马懿的嘴角，滴滴答答全流到了衣服上。
page_text_en:
The maid hurried over and helped Sima Yi sit up on the bed.
Sima Yi pointed to his mouth, and the maid immediately brought a bowl of porridge. Sima Yi took the bowl and tried to drink it himself, but his hands trembled so much that he couldn't bring the bowl to his mouth. The maid took the bowl back and fed him spoon by spoon. The porridge dripped from the corners of Sima Yi's mouth, spilling all over his clothes.
summary_zh: 司马懿假装病重，婢女喂他喝粥，他手抖无法自食，粥流到衣服上，以示病情严重。

page_text_ocr_zh: 李胜等司马懿喝完了粥，站在床边躬身说："司马公，好久没来拜望您。听说您旧病复发，没想到这么严重，还请多多保重身体。我被任命为荆州刺史，今天特来向您辞行。"司马懿靠在床上，有气无力地说："并州？你要做并州刺史了？好呀好呀，并州是边境重地，胡人常来侵犯，你一定要训练好军队，时刻提防呀！"
page_text_en: Li Sheng waited until Sima Yi finished his porridge, then stood by the bed and bowed, saying: "Lord Sima, it's been a long time since I last visited you. I heard your old illness has flared up again. I didn't expect it to be this serious. Please take good care of yourself. I have been appointed as the governor of Jingzhou, and I come today to bid you farewell." Sima Yi, leaning on the bed, weakly replied: "Jingzhou? You're going to be the governor of Jingzhou? Good, good! Jingzhou is a frontier stronghold, often invaded by the barbarians. You must train your troops well and always stay vigilant!"
summary_zh: 李胜前来探望病中的司马懿，谎称自己被任命为荆州刺史，司马懿却故意听错为并州，并叮嘱他要训练军队、提防胡人，以此掩饰自己的真实状况。

page_text_ocr_zh:
是荆州!!
李胜忙大声说道：“我是回家乡荆州做刺史，不是并州。”司马懿指了指自己的耳朵说：“唉，我上了年纪，耳朵聋了，你说的话也听不清楚了。如今你回了家乡并州，正好大展雄才，轰轰烈烈地干一番大事业。我那两个不成器的儿子，要是能像你一样能干就好喽，以后还请你多多关照他们呀!”
page_text_en:
It's Jingzhou!!
Li Sheng hurriedly shouted, "I'm returning to my hometown Jingzhou to serve as governor, not Bingzhou." Sima Yi pointed to his ears and said, "Ah, I'm old now, my ears are deaf, I can't hear you clearly. Now that you're returning to your hometown Bingzhou, you can finally achieve great things and make a grand career. My two unworthy sons—if only they could be as capable as you! Please take good care of them in the future!"
summary_zh: 李胜前来探望病中的司马懿，明确告知自己将赴荆州任职，司马懿假装耳聋，故意听错为并州，并叮嘱其训练军队、关照儿子，以掩饰自己真实状况。

page_text_ocr_zh: 司马懿说话头不对马嘴，李胜离开他家后，就向曹爽禀告："司马公已经老糊涂了，喝水漏水，喝粥漏粥；耳朵也聋了，荆州、并州都分不清，肯定活不长了。"曹爽听了一拍大腿，高兴地说："这我就放心了，哈哈，没什么好怕的了。"
page_text_en: Simashi's words were incoherent. After Li Sheng left his house, he reported to Cao Shuang: "Lord Sima is completely senile now—water leaks from his mouth when he drinks, porridge spills when he eats; his ears are deaf, he can't even distinguish between Jingzhou and Bingzhou. He won't live much longer." Cao Shuang slapped his thigh and happily said: "Now I'm at ease, haha, there's nothing to fear anymore."
summary_zh: 李胜向曹爽汇报司马懿病重且神志不清，曹爽听后大为安心，认为已无后顾之忧。

page_text_ocr_zh: 等到正月的时候，皇帝要出城，去高平陵拜祭他的父亲。曹爽兄弟三人，领着禁军保护皇帝一同前去。司马懿见曹爽兄弟出了城，也不装病了，骑上马，精气神十足。他跟两个儿子率领人马，闯进了皇宫，占领了武器库，关闭了各个城门。他还抓住了皇帝的母亲，让她撤了曹爽兄弟三人的官职。
page_text_en: When it was the first month, the emperor was going out of the city to pay respects at his father's tomb in Gaopingling. Cao Shuang and his two brothers led the imperial guards to protect the emperor. Sima Yi, seeing that Cao Shuang's brothers had left the city, stopped pretending to be ill. He mounted his horse, full of energy. With his two sons, he led his troops, stormed into the palace, seized the armory, and closed all the city gates. He also captured the emperor's mother and had her remove the official positions of Cao Shuang and his two brothers.
summary_zh: 司马懿趁曹爽兄弟出城拜祭时，率军发动政变，控制皇宫、武器库和城门，并挟持皇帝母亲，废除曹爽兄弟的官职。

page_text_ocr_zh: 曹爽得知消息，在城外急得团团转。司马懿派来使者，劝曹爽投降：“只要交出兵权，司马公就会放过你们。”曹爽手里握着刀想了一夜，直到清晨，他突然站起身来，“哐啷”一声，把刀扔在地上，大声说：“投降就投降！不就是丢官吗？我还可以享受我的荣华富贵！”便向司马懿投了降。
page_text_en: Cao Shuang learned the news and paced anxiously outside the city. Sima Yi sent an envoy to urge Cao Shuang to surrender: "As long as you hand over your military power, Lord Sima will spare you." Cao Shuang held the sword and thought for a whole night. At dawn, he suddenly stood up, "clank" went the sword as he threw it to the ground, shouting loudly: "Surrender, then! What's the big deal about losing my official position? I can still enjoy my wealth and glory!" He then surrendered to Sima Yi.
summary_zh: 曹爽在城外得知司马懿发动政变后陷入恐慌，最终在使者劝降下，放弃抵抗，交出兵权，向司马懿投降。

page_text_ocr_zh: 从此之后，魏国的大权又回到了司马懿手中。十几年后，司马懿的孙子夺了皇位，当了魏国的皇帝。在斗不赢曹爽的时候，司马懿装病装傻，说自己耳聋眼花，骗过了曹爽，让他不再提防自己。等到曹爽出城，时机一来，司马懿便一举夺下都城，成功夺权。这种装疯卖傻，等待有利时机再行动的计谋，就叫“假痴不癫”。
page_text_en: From then on, the power of the Wei state returned to Sima Yi. Years later, Sima Yi's grandson seized the throne and became emperor of Wei. When he couldn't defeat Cao Shuang, Sima Yi pretended to be ill and foolish, claiming he was deaf and blind, deceiving Cao Shuang and making him no longer wary. When Cao Shuang left the city, the moment came, and Sima Yi seized the capital in one move, successfully taking power. This strategy of pretending to be mad and foolish, waiting for the right opportunity to act, is called 'feigning madness and stupidity'.
summary_zh: 本页总结了司马懿通过装病装傻骗过曹爽，趁其出城时发动政变夺权，并最终由其孙子建立晋朝的历史结果，点明了“假痴不癫”的计谋含义。
